annotations.title: Sun position and shadow length for a building site

description: Sun azimuth and elevation, shadow length per metre of building height and shadow direction for a building site on a given day and local times (Central European time), plus sunrise and sunset. Use for orientation, terrace or window planning and quick shadow questions. Looks the site up by town or address via OpenStreetMap. A study on flat ground without neighbouring buildings, not a legal shadow certificate.

building_height_m.description: Height of the building or wall in metres, to give shadow lengths in metres

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German) or "en" (English). Default "de".

site.description: Town, postcode or street address of the building site, e.g. "8010 Graz" or "Lindenweg 7, Linz"

name: vedutum_sun_and_shadow
